nom: COSRX Red Rice Inositol Exfoliating Pore Care Wash-Off Peel Serum

segments.mature: A reviewer identifying as a grandmother with dark spots and wrinkles reports the peel is gentle yet effective, leaving skin soft and smooth.
segments.oily: One reviewer uses it 2-3 times a week specifically when her skin feels oily and clogged, reporting significant dead skin shedding and softer results afterward.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer reporting dark spots and wrinkles describes the product as gentle and effective, with soft, smooth results.
concerns.spots: The same mature-skin reviewer with dark spots reports positive results, though only one review addresses this concern.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer mentions using the product when her skin feels 'clogged,' reporting a large amount of dead skin shedding and clearer-feeling skin afterward.

aspects.libelle: Visible dead skin shedding during use
Enhances absorption of following skincare steps
Gentle enough for mature or sensitive-feeling skin

extraits.texte: Wow! This serum has definitely improved the my skin's texture, appearance, and actually appears to reduce the size of pores on and around my nose area. This doesn't dry out my skin either! Use it daily and no side effects.

extraits.titre: Must buy from Cosrx. Butter soft skin.
extraits.texte: Amazing. I use it 2-3 times a week when my face is just feeling oily and clogged and super icky feeling, and I absolutely love the results. The amount of dead skin that sheds off of me is unbelievable. Sorry no pic but the dead skin just kept falling off my face and was covering my sink and kinda gross but worth it. After using it I do my normal nighty skincare routine and wake up with the most buttery soft skin ever. I am super happy to have purchased this because it has certainly exceeded my expectations. This is a must buy from the COSRX line!

Oh my god! I used this for the first time tonight after using the red rice cleanser. I've been using the cleanser for a bit and love it, but hadn't tried the exfoliator yet. My face has literally never felt like this. I have a lot of exfoliators that I like, but this is amazing. My skin is softer than it's ever been and looks great too! Bonus, it seems to work on your hands while you're using it, because my hands feel so much nicer too! I will never stop buying this.

Tried this out for the first time, and I have to say, I love it! It helps exfoliate my skin, and makes it feel really smooth. I also feel like it helps the rest of my routine sink in better. Also noticing smaller pores in just a few uses.

As a grandma my skin has a lot of issues, dark spots and wrinkles. This was amazing, plus fun to use. Gentle on the skin and the results are soft smooth skin. Exfoliating is the key and this is gentle and effective.
I've used it once so far but it definitely had an affect on my skin. My pores were visibly smaller and it improved the texture of my skin
Was skeptical at first but after the first couple well I could feel my skin getting smoother.

reserve: All 9 reviews are 5-star and mostly brief, so there is no critical or lower-rated review to include, and segment/concern coverage beyond oily and mature skin is thin.
